source_review.notes: Reviewed all eight references for architecture-description semantics, C4 abstractions and diagram levels, notation guidance, UML semantics, views, architecture practice, and visual communication. Official C4 abstraction, diagram, and notation pages and the OMG UML 2.5.1 PDF returned HTTP 200. The ISO 42010 catalogue returned HTTP 403 to curl; its current 2022 edition and scope were independently confirmed from the official catalogue.

evidence: Reviewed model, graphical mark, interpretation, legend, scope, correspondence, version, element, relation, and constraint domains in D=(M,G,iota,L,S,C,V).
Confirmed graphical and model types, encoding, relation kind, coverage population, and represented-claim notation is defined before use.

evidence: Recomputed Exercise 2 declared coverage as 6/8=75 percent.
Recomputed coverage after excluding the ambiguous color encoding as 5/8=62.5 percent.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Both rates retain the declared eight-claim denominator and are not treated as truth or readability measures.

evidence: Verified interpretation is functional only when each meaningful glyph has one model interpretation in its context.
Checked injective encoding over used relation kinds makes distinct kinds distinguishable under readable labels and a known legend.
Verified semantic coverage counts represented required claims without implying correctness or sufficiency.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The distinction result addresses one ambiguity class and explicitly excludes model truth and audience comprehension.

evidence: Reviewed unlabeled arrows, C4 container confusion, pseudo-UML, overloaded color, mixed abstraction, accidental proximity, static/dynamic conflation, incomplete discovery, ambiguous trust boundary, and emergency-response visualization.
Checked monochrome rendering, automatic layout, stale generation, dormant paths, manual image edits, mixed lifecycle states, missing external systems, and inaccessible legends.

evidence: Traced explicit semantics, bounded abstraction, recoverable relationship meaning, typed boundaries, stable cross-view identity, accessible rendering, governed source, audience interpretation, evidence-backed claims, and unexplained-style prohibition throughout.
Confirmed logical system, C4 container, UML component, source module, runtime instance, deployment node, and data authority remain distinct.

evidence: Reviewed the injective-encoding argument for distinguishability of relationship kinds.
Confirmed distinct relation kinds cannot share the same encoding under injectivity.
Confirmed the result does not prove viewers know the legend, labels are readable, relations are true, or the model is complete.
proof_review.notes: The proof is narrowly scoped to representational distinguishability.

evidence: Audited uses of prove, formal, conforming, valid, correct, complete, current, authoritative, accessible, and evidence.
Verified that standards, generated diagrams, coverage, consistency checks, and internal review remain bounded evidence.

empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No audience study, rendering experiment, model-tool execution, repository discovery, executable snippet, or reproduced empirical result is presented.

Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified first-principles visual-model vocabulary, derived interpretation and coverage models, thirteen misconceptions, ten distinct worked examples, and five progressive exercises with complete answers ending in unfamiliar wildfire-command transfer.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
